Container.Name: ai-tg-bot
Container.Overview: Pi-powered Telegram agent with one persistent custom E2B Base sandbox per Telegram thread.
Container.Requires: Telegram, E2B, OpenRouter, and Tavily API keys. Browser Use Cloud, Codex OAuth, and Docling are optional.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, Pi sessions, and OAuth configuration.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: BotFather token.

Config.Name: E2B API Key
Config.Description: E2B API key used to create and resume per-thread sandboxes.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: OpenRouter key for fallback inference, image generation, and embeddings.

Config.Name: Tavily API Key
Config.Description: Tavily key for web search and extraction.

Config.Name: Browser Use API Key
Config.Description: Optional Browser Use Cloud key for interactive browsing and Office visual QA.

Config.Name: Browser Use Deployment ID
Config.Description: Stable Browser Use profile namespace. Use a different value for each deployment sharing an account.

Config.Name: Browser Use Default Session
Config.Description: Default Browser Use Cloud session duration in minutes (5-240).

Config.Name: Browser Use Idle Timeout
Config.Description: Idle time in milliseconds before Browser Use Cloud sessions are stopped.

Config.Name: Browser Use API Timeout
Config.Description: Browser Use Cloud API request timeout in milliseconds.

Config.Name: Browser Use Navigation Timeout
Config.Description: Browser navigation timeout in milliseconds.

Config.Name: E2B Template
Config.Description: Reusable custom E2B template reference. Build it explicitly before starting the bot; runtime never installs it.

Config.Name: E2B Deployment ID
Config.Description: Stable ownership namespace for sandbox recovery. Use a different value for each deployment sharing an E2B account.

Config.Name: E2B Request Timeout
Config.Description: Control-plane request timeout in milliseconds.

Config.Name: Telegram Restore Timeout
Config.Description: Telegram restoration and large E2B file-transfer timeout in milliseconds.

Config.Name: Telegram Restore Concurrency
Config.Description: Concurrent sandbox-side Telegram downloads.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLite or PostgreSQL database URL.

Config.Name: Pi Agent Directory
Config.Description: Persistent Pi configuration, OAuth credentials, and thread sessions.

Config.Name: Docling URL
Config.Description: Optional external Docling server.

Config.Name: Application UID
Config.Description: Non-root UID used by the bot.

Config.Name: Application GID
Config.Description: Primary non-root GID used by the bot.

Config.Name: Bash Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum milliseconds for one foreground sandbox command.

Config.Name: Bash Max Output
Config.Description: Maximum characters returned for each stdout or stderr stream.

Config.Name: Pi Turn Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum milliseconds for a Pi turn.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn, or error.
